name: Filter or leak
mechanism: Admit a randomised holdout with the identity check removed and compare ninety-day revenue, support load and realised abuse loss against the friction saved, so you learn whether the people leaving were ever worth keeping.

name: Reverse the message direction
mechanism: Have the person send an inbound message to you rather than waiting on an outbound code, which removes spam filtering, carrier throughput and delivery latency from the failure surface entirely.

name: Capability ceiling priced to abuse
mechanism: Grant everyone a capped amount of the capability whose worst-case misuse cost is below the marginal value of a confirmed person, and escalate the check only when consumption crosses that cost line.

name: Provisional record, reconciled later
mechanism: Issue a temporary identifier that carries full function immediately and run the identity match asynchronously as a background reconciliation job rather than a blocking gate.

name: Learned gate most never see
mechanism: Score arrivals on realised-abuse outcomes and require the check only from the scored minority, retraining the scorer on actual losses so the exempted share grows as the model improves.

name: The inviter posts the bond
mechanism: Make the existing customer who invited them stake their own standing or credit, transferring liability to the party who already knows the person and has an incentive to be right.

name: Load the wait with switching cost
mechanism: Fill the in-flight waiting window with data import, connection and naming work so irreversible investment accrues in the exact window where attention would otherwise be idle.

name: Move the check to consequence
mechanism: Relocate the identity requirement to the first irreversible or money-moving action rather than arrival, so it is paid against something the person already wants.

name: Refundable economic hostage
mechanism: Take a reversible hold on a payment instrument as the accountability anchor, substituting an economic stake for proof of who someone is.

name: Meter the requirement's owner
mechanism: Show the team that owns the rule the live revenue cost of their own threshold so the group setting the friction is the group feeling its price.
